title: Site Architecture
summary: Sitemap of marketing-site routes with rationale, navigation structure, and out-of-scope items; banner marks part already built.
notes: Manifest-declared DOC, precedence 3. Doc carries a 'Built so far (July 2026)' banner: shipped routes are /, /about, /contact, /properties, /properties/[slug], /news under the (site) route group plus the /admin panel behind a password gate in proxy.ts; all other routes in the table (/communities, /communities/[slug], /agents, /agents/[slug], /services/*, /journal, /journal/[slug], /list-with-us) are longer-term target, not built. Note also the route-group discrepancy: table text says (marketing), banner says (site). Explicit non-scope this phase: MLS/IDX sync, buyer portal/login, saved-search/favorites, multi-language routing.
